text:
Kai W: Heads-up — noticed p95 regression on prod after yesterday's kernel roll + new jitter tweak. p95 up ~18% on chat routes.
Maria L: Repro'd on staging with replay. KV hit-rate dropped ~7% when microbatch interval lowered to 3ms.
Samir P: Ran a short profile on perf-runner: kernel selection flips to fallback-gemm for a bunch of seq_len=256 requests, which adds ~0.9ms/token for those steps. Also saw higher fraction of 1-item batches.
Maria L: timeline — we changed microbatch_interval_ms from 5 -> 3 and coalesce_delay from 2 -> 1. Early wins for latency median, but tail suffered.
Samir P: Perf snippet:
```
perf_summary:
p50: 6.2ms
p95: 22.8ms  (+18%)
kv_hit_rate: 0.73 -> 0.66
avg_batch_size: 2.3 -> 1.6
microbatch_interval_ms: 3
coalesce_delay_ms: 1.0
jitter_ms: 0.5
kernel_path: fallback-gemm for seq in [200..300]
```
Kai W: Hypothesis: smaller microbatch_interval + small coalesce delay reduces batching opportunity and jitter pattern increases KV churn so we lose cache hits and push some requests into slower kernels.
Nora S: Also check seq_len histogram — tokenizer change last week bumped mid-length messages. That could push us over kernel-selection thresholds.
Maria L: Two quick knobs to try for canary: bump coalesce_delay to 2.5ms, increase jitter to 1.2ms (to spread arrival alignment), and bump token_budget target from 32 -> 48 so we allow slightly larger batches for chat routes.
Samir P: Agree. Add a route-scoped queue policy: prefer-age for chat (helps p95) and prefer-size for embedding routes. That keeps embeddings from getting penalized.
Kai W: Can we also add a tiny kernel-selection guard: if seq_len in [200..300] prefer-opt-kernel-with-lower-overhead even if slightly lower throughput? Might reduce per-token tail.
Samir P: I'll implement the canary toggles now. Plan: 5% traffic split, 1hr run, collect p50/p95, avg_batch_size, kv_hit, kernel-switch rate.
infra-bot: canary-rollout — initiated by samir (canary id c-2024-1729) :rocket:
devex-bot: experiment logged: /experiments/batching/1729456789-queue-sidekick-v1 — tags: canary, kv, kernel, jitter
Maria L: quick note — prefer-age helped last time on chat but added cost on small tail-requests; will watch cost delta.
Nora S: Also capture per-device kernel choice histogram — we saw device-specific micro-variability before.
Kai W: Sweet. Samir please post the perf dump and a small tl;dr in this thread when done. If p95 improves and kv_hit recovers, good to promote.
Samir P: Will do. Starting canary now, will ping after 1hr with charts.
Maria L: thanks — if we see any regression I can flip fallback quickly. :thumbsup:
Kai W: Great.
